sql: SELECT id, title, status, published_at FROM article;
SELECT id, kind, text, article, created_at FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull';
SELECT id, kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE article = article:a19 OR article = article:a33 OR article = article:a12 OR article = article:a28 OR article = article:a41;
SELECT id, status, body FROM article WHERE id IN [article:a19, article:a33, article:a12, article:a28, article:a41];
SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox;
SELECT parent, count() FROM passage WHERE parent IN [article:a19, article:a33, article:a12, article:a28, article:a41, article:a1, article:a2] GROUP BY parent;
SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
SELECT id, title, status, body, desk, published_at FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23'] ORDER BY status;
SELECT id, kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE kind = 't2' OR article IN [article:a7, article:a5, article:a19];
